test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fabricate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Construct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fabricate"** means to make or construct something, often with the connotation of producing something artificial or deceitful. (निर्माण करना; बनाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The engineer was able to fabricate a prototype of the machine in just two weeks.
 
 
 
• **"Construct"** refers to the act of building or assembling something, typically in a systematic way. (निर्माण करना)
 
 
• **Example: **They decided to construct a new bridge over the river to improve connectivity.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **'Fabricate' **is **'Construct'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Construct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Garments **(वस्त्र): Items of clothing or apparel.

 
 
• **Example:** The store has a wide variety of garments to choose from.
 
 
 
• **Fascinate **(मोहित करना): To attract or hold someone’s attention by being interesting or charming.
 
 
• **Example: **The magician’s tricks never fail to fascinate the audience.
 
 
 
• **Floral** (फूलों से संबंधित): Relating to or made of flowers.
 
 
• **Example:** She wore a beautiful dress with a floral pattern for the party.
